rows.note: This is the all-purpose everyday word for an electric fan.

example.english: It's so hot—leave the fan on.
example.jyutping: gam3 jit6 hoi1 zyu6 baa2 fung1 sin3 laa1

rows.note: Use this for a supporter or admirer, especially of a performer, team, or public figure.

example.english: I'm a fan of this team.
example.jyutping: ngo5 hai6 ni1 deoi6 bo1 ge3 fan2 si1

rows.note: Use this for an enthusiast of a particular interest, usually in compounds such as 車迷 or 球迷.

example.english: I'm a car fan, so I stop to look whenever I see a nice car.
example.traditional: 我係車迷，見到靚車就停低睇。
example.jyutping: ngo5 hai6 ce1 mai4 gin3 dou2 leng3 ce1 zau6 ting4 dai1 tai2

rows.note: Use this for a hand-held folding fan rather than an electric fan.

example.english: I take a hand fan when I go out.
example.jyutping: ngo5 ceot1 gaai1 wui5 daai3 baa2 sin3
